coordinates.objectTransformPolicy: exclude saved scene placement and object scale; use armature data rest matrices

skeleton.optionalParentPolicy: present joints retain the nearest profile parent; include ancestor closure; non-joint containers are allowed
skeleton.additionalJointPolicy: reject unknown joint names in human.v1

animation.fallbackTerminal: reject unresolved request; special/cross modifiers require explicit binding
animation.clock: host ADB phase; visual time = phase * clip duration
animation.missingStartEnd: zero visual transition; retain host duration
animation.variantAmbiguity: reject multiple matches at equal priority
animation.cycleClock: modulo normalized phase; unique clamp; death hold last frame

events.authority: host gameplay events, no duplicate damage/projectiles from renderer
events.delivery: (previous,current]; split loops; time zero once per action/cycle; suppress historic events on seek/load

materials.gammaBoundary: 4edc1a2 display-encoded renderer; decode sRGB for linear operations then encode once before legacy color input

gltf.unsupportedOptionalExtension: ignore only with valid core fallback
